name: smwmusic-sunburst
title: Sunburst
description:
Sunbeams shining through the treetops, in a yellowish glow.
There's a little creature sitting on a mossy stone...
"A a, a, a... grrl"
What does it mean?

Original song inspired by the Casio Mario World OST and some samples in the samples of insanity pack. Could fit weird and forest or water themed levels, maybe?
